draft_key_information_units.information: In H1 2026, consolidated EBIT increased by 94% to EUR 51.1 million (from EUR 26.4 million in H1 2025) and EBITDA rose by 31% to EUR 111.2 million (from EUR 85.1 million). Revenue remained broadly unchanged at EUR 946 million (vs EUR 952 million in H1 2025), while net profit turned positive at EUR 7.2 million (compared to a loss of EUR 14.4 million in H1 2025). The group invested approximately EUR 50 million during H1 2026.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures for Q2 2026 (I12), Management Report (I6)

draft_key_information_units.information: H1 2026 segment EBITDA was EUR 39.3 million for maritime transport (vs EUR 33.3 million in H1 2025), EUR 59.9 million for energy (vs EUR 51.7 million), and EUR 8.1 million for real estate (vs EUR 7.7 million). Supporting segments contributed EBITDA of EUR -2.1 million, improving from a loss of EUR -4.4 million in H1 2025.

In Q2 2026, Tallink Grupp carried 1,454,725 passengers (-2.2% YoY), 68,986 cargo units (+2.9%), and 199,025 passenger vehicles (-6.5%). The segment reported a net loss of EUR 2.5 million (unchanged YoY), impacted by higher fuel costs (up EUR 8.4 million vs Q2 2025), full EU ETS emissions surrender (100% of CO2 equivalent vs 70% in 2025), and the 36-month charter of the Superfast IX vessel from May 2026.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026: Maritime transport business segment (I7)

draft_key_information_units.information: Elenger Grupp's Q2 2026 gas and electricity sales volumes decreased by 34% to 3.3 TWh (from 4.9 TWh in Q2 2025), primarily due to reduced wholesale sales. The segment held a 29% market share in the Finnish-Baltic gas market. During the period, Elenger commissioned a 4.5 MW battery energy storage system in Liepāja, Latvia, and Polish subsidiaries secured a EUR 60 million loan agreement to expand the Polish gas business.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026: Energy business segment (I7-I8)

draft_key_information_units.information: INF Infra continued construction of Rail Baltica's mainline on the Kangru-Saku section (contract value EUR 67.2 million, scheduled to continue until March 2028). Construction of the Depo DIY store adjacent to the Tallink Tennis Centre progressed, with completion planned for autumn 2026. Renovation of 166 rooms at Tallink Express Hotel was completed in May 2026 following closure for renovations since November 2025.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in Q2 2026: Real Estate Development and Construction Projects (I8)

draft_key_information_units.information: Cash and cash equivalents increased to EUR 253.2 million as at 30 June 2026 (from EUR 146.4 million at 31 December 2025). Operating cash flow for H1 2026 was EUR 99.5 million, reflecting cash flow management and the maintenance of a liquidity buffer to finance new investments.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures for Q2 2026 (I12), Consolidated Cash Flow Statement (I19)

draft_key_information_units.information: Total loan and lease liabilities stood at EUR 1,083.1 million as at 30 June 2026, with net debt at EUR 829.9 million (down from EUR 851.6 million at 31 December 2025). The net debt/EBITDA ratio improved to 3.3x (from 3.7x at the end of 2025).
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key Figures for Q2 2026 (I12), Note 7: Financial Liabilities (I33)

draft_key_information_units.information: Shareholders approved a dividend of EUR 3.02 per share for the 2025 financial year, with payment dates scheduled for 15 July 2026 and 15 December 2026.
draft_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report (I6), Share Price and Shareholders (I10)

evaluation.selection_rationale: The draft units prioritize headline financial performance (D1), major segment results and drivers (D2-D5), liquidity and capital position (D6-D7), and material strategic events (D8). Each unit represents a core, independently omittable theme essential for understanding Infortar's financial health, operational trends, and strategic direction. Units D1-D5 and D7-D8 align with the reference summary's focus on performance, segments, and key events. D6 (liquidity) is included at MEDIUM importance as it provides context for investment capacity but is less central to profitability analysis. All figures are directly supported by the source report without external knowledge or invented relationships.
